npc_batterfly:
Found in caverns (where the perpetual darkness may account for their pissy mood) it has been shown that Batterflies, when fed at one end, produce useful agricultural materials from the other.
What it gives: Guano
Quests: Batterfly Bounty Booster, Batterfly Bounty Booster II
npc_blimp: Or is it zeppelin? I always forget. Anyway, it goes over like a led balloon.
npc_butterfly:
A morphously blue butterfly. As any fool knows, butter can't fly, but milk apparently can. Butterflies may need a little kindness (or massage) before they give up the milk, but milk can always be…
What it gives: Butterfly Milk
Quests: A L'il Animal Kinship, Happy Endings For All!, Nibble, Milk and Squeeze TO THE MAX, Go Moloko Loco, Butterfly Style, Doin' the Ol' MacDonald, Master Milker, Aranna Scramble, Animal Q-razy
Achievements: Apprentice Lepidopteral Manipulator, Master Lepidopteral Manipulator, Nigh-Mystical Lepidopteral Manipulator, Practical Lepidopteral Manipulator
Where it comes from: Cactus
npc_cactus:
Hidden away in a scorching place, the Cactus has seen things he can never unsee. You can try to help, but help is limited. Do not, whatever you do, consider hugging the cactus.
What it gives: Butterfly, Zzybzfrx
npc_chicken:
In Tiny Speck’s game: An easily agitated member of the poultry classes. Given to flights of fearful fantasy, high-pitched paranoia and, frankly, short distances, chickens are a reliable source of grain (it's said that they keep it in the hot pockets under their wings).
What it gives: Grain
Quests: Nibble, Milk and Squeeze TO THE MAX, Chicken Music Block Combo, Animal Q-razy
Achievements: Hen Hugger, Hen Hugger Deluxe, Hen Hugger Supremalicious, The Hugginator
npc_crab:
Anyone knows music makes crabs happy, but it takes an expert DJ to satiate both the appetite for variety and yen for classic tunes it desires. The tunesmith who can play a full array of Music Blocks…
What it gives: Crabato Juice, CrabPod Headphones
Quests: Color Unblocking

npc_deimaginator: Enemies of imagination, these shadowy figures are locked in an eternal struggle to stop the trafficking of mysterious contraband. Beware of their grabby little hands!
npc_dustbunny:
An ikkle fwuffy cutesy wutesy Dust Bunny. As cute as a small fluffy ball made of dead skin and discarded hair can be, at any rate. Still, at least it's polite.
Quests: De-Embiggenify, De-Embiggenify II
npc_firefly:
The perfect alliance of science and nature, the dowdy brown coat of the firefly when landed belies their beauty when in flight: a heart of gold, a tiny buzzy fizzling flying flame. Thought to have…
Quests: Firefly Whistle
npc_fox:
The sly, cunning, quick brown fox has a tail full of fibers perfect for spinning. Shifting position quickly, you can rely on a fox to be fast-paced, slippery and hard to pin down, they care deeply…
What it gives: Fiber
Quests: Weird n' Wild
Achievements: Cunning like a Foxbrusher, Delirious Foxbrusher, Fox Flurrier, Happy Foxbrusher, Maniacal Foxbrusher
npc_juju_bandit:
The scourge of the Baqala, the Juju Bandits roam the ancestral lands with an insatiable hunger for other people's stuff. Particularly fond of paper, a Juju bandit can be outfoxed, outrun, or…
Quests: Carry That Weight
npc_kitty_chicken:
This kitty never needs to worry about landing on its feet.
What it gives: Grain
npc_piggy:
One happy little porcine with a laidback attitude to life and a lot of love to give. Whether wild or domestic, the piggy gives wisdom from one end, useful gardening supplies from the other, and…
What it gives: Hog-tied Piggy, Meat

npc_sloth:
Slow-moving, metal-loving, laid-back, rod-eating and snail-spitting the Sloth is not, contrary to popular opinion, lovable and lazy. The sloth is merely conserving energy. What for? The sloth will…
